integrity: Analytical theorem and a finite same-model numerical matrix-construction check; classical Chebyshev scalar design credited; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed distinct radial offsets and strictly positive weights; equally spaced angular quadrature with M>=2n-1 on each radius; asymptotic epsilon to zero at fixed truncation, squared-radius center t>0; no finite-epsilon global optimum or nonlinear/physical-state noise bound.
title: Sharp radial-collapse law and Chebyshev–Lobatto design for finite Gaussian coherent-state tomography
